comments.author: Steward
comments.body: I can't find it. You know where is it?

comments.author: Jafar
comments.body: This is an Inland city. You need to complete a long series of High Rank Adventure quests to discover this special city. You won't find this on your world map, because it's in the same location as Lima, but further inland. The legendary city of Machu Picchu is near Cusco.

comments.author: Montador
comments.body: Just to give you an idea: You need 60,000 battle fame, 30,000 adventure, Appraisal r14, Search r12, Unlock r12, Archeaology r12 to do the quests needed to get Cusco.
